key.name: system-prompt
key.default: "You are GNOME Assistant, available from the GNOME Shell overview. Help the user answer questions, understand their workspace, and complete tasks they request. Lead with the answer or outcome and keep replies concise. Use Markdown for steps, code, and file paths when it helps. When working in a project, follow its conventions and preserve the user's existing changes. Explain what you changed, what you verified, and anything you could not verify. Respect the permissions set by the user and ask for clarification when a missing detail would materially change the result."
key.summary: Assistant context for chats started from the extension

key.name: assistant-name
key.summary: Assistant name
key.description: The name shown for the assistant in the chat, the prompt, notifications and the Files menu.

key.name: custom-instructions
key.summary: Personal instructions appended to the system prompt

key.name: auto-delegate
key.summary: Let the assistant delegate independent work automatically

key.name: web-research
key.summary: Research on the web
key.description: Ask the agent to check facts online with its own web tools instead of answering from memory.

key.name: acp-profile
key.summary: Selected ACP connection ID

key.name: acp-profiles
key.summary: Local and SSH ACP connection profiles

key.name: acp-config-values
key.summary: Preferred ACP session configuration values per connection

key.name: acp-config-state
key.summary: Agent-advertised configuration for the preferences window

key.name: workspace-folder
key.summary: Absolute path to the local workspace

key.name: memory-enabled
key.summary: Save agent conversations
key.description: When enabled, the extension keeps local transcripts. The connected agent manages its own session persistence.

key.name: toggle-ai-mode
key.summary: Toggle AI mode shortcut
key.description: Global keyboard shortcut used to open the overview and toggle AI mode.

key.name: show-status-indicator
key.summary: Show the assistant status in the top bar
key.description: While a reply is running, waiting for an approval or ready to read, show an indicator in the top bar. Notifications are shown either way.

key.name: privacy-protection
key.summary: Protect secrets and private windows
key.description: Redact secrets from what is sent to the agent, ask before sending secrets you typed or attached, leave sensitive files out of folders, and black out private windows (and, with Tesseract installed, secret-looking text) in screenshots.

key.name: privacy-hidden-apps
key.summary: Apps never shown in screenshots
key.description: App IDs whose windows are blacked out in screenshots sent to the agent, in addition to password managers and authenticator apps.

key.name: problem-crashes
key.summary: Notify about crashes
key.description: Offer to ask the assistant when a program you use crashes.

key.name: problem-memory
key.summary: Notify about out-of-memory kills
key.description: Offer to ask the assistant when a program is closed because memory ran out.

key.name: problem-services
key.summary: Notify about failed services
key.description: Offer to ask the assistant when a user or system service fails.

key.name: problem-background
key.summary: Include background processes
key.description: Also notify about crashes of helper processes that have no window.

key.name: problem-ignored
key.summary: Problems not to notify about
key.description: Programs (program:NAME) and services (service:UNIT) the user chose not to be notified about.

key.name: desktop-context-enabled
key.summary: Enable the desktop context shortcut
key.description: When enabled, a separate shortcut captures a screenshot of each monitor and attaches it to the next message.

key.name: desktop-context-screenshots
key.summary: Include screenshots in the desktop context
key.description: A screenshot of each monitor. Requires an agent that accepts images.

key.name: desktop-context-focused-window
key.summary: Include the focused window in the desktop context
key.description: Title, application, monitor, workspace and position of the window with keyboard focus.

key.name: desktop-context-windows
key.summary: Include open windows and workspaces in the desktop context
key.description: Titles, applications and positions of open windows on every workspace, and the workspace count.

key.name: desktop-context-pointer
key.summary: Include the mouse position in the desktop context
key.description: Pointer position, its monitor and the window under it.

key.name: desktop-context-selection
key.summary: Include selected text in the desktop context
key.description: When enabled, the desktop context includes the text currently highlighted in an application (the primary selection).

key.name: desktop-context-projects
key.summary: Include project directories in the desktop context
key.description: Project directories inferred from window titles and terminal working directories.

key.name: desktop-context-events
key.summary: Include recent desktop events in the desktop context
key.description: Notifications, opened and closed windows, application crashes and logged errors from the last five minutes. Notifications and windows are kept in memory only while this is enabled.

key.name: desktop-context-app-logs
key.summary: Include application logs in the desktop context
key.description: Let the agent read recent journal logs of the applications whose windows are in the desktop context.

key.name: desktop-context-device-status
key.summary: Include device status in the desktop context
key.description: Network, audio, Bluetooth, power and session status of this computer.

key.name: desktop-context-skip-local
key.summary: Skip details a local agent can read itself
key.description: For agents running on this computer, leave out device status, crashes, logged errors and application logs, and tell the agent which commands read them. Agents over SSH always receive them.

key.name: window-context-enabled
key.summary: Enable window context
key.description: Offer "Ask" in every window's menu, and the window context shortcut, to attach one window's screenshot and context.

key.name: open-with-window-context
key.summary: Open with window context shortcut
key.description: Global keyboard shortcut that attaches the focused window's context, then opens the assistant.

key.name: open-with-desktop-context
key.summary: Open with desktop context shortcut
key.description: Global keyboard shortcut that captures the desktop, then opens the assistant with the capture attached.

key.name: codex-workspace
key.summary: Legacy workspace path used only during settings migration

key.name: settings-migrated
key.summary: Whether legacy extension preferences have been migrated

key.name: codex-workspace
key.summary: Legacy workspace path used only during settings migration
